cues: Here is the trap that costs marks every year.
v equals r omega, s equals r theta, and torque equals I alpha are true only when angles are in radians.
If a question gives revolutions per minute, convert first.
One revolution is two pi radians, so N revolutions per minute means omega equals two pi N over sixty radians per second.
